name: Sticky Stacked-Card Scroll
use: Consecutive sections pin under the header and stack like cards; each covered card shrinks to 0.94 and dims as the next slides over it.
notes: position: sticky only; section heights untouched. Auto-switches ancestor overflow:hidden to overflow-x:clip (Custom CSS fallback in INSTALL). Off below 768px by default. Not yet verified on a live Squarespace site — real #siteWrapper/#page overflow rules there are unconfirmed.
